description: This file defines a migration class for version 4.3.5 of the OrangeHRM system. The class extends an abstract migration class and includes methods to apply the migration (which is empty) and to get the migration version.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class representing a database migration for the OrangeHRM system, specific to version 4.3.5, providing methods to execute and identify the migration.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Defines the operations to perform during the migration process; currently, no database changes are needed for this version.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '4.3.5' indicating this migration's target version.
